# ChivaCare Chiang Mai (ชีวาแคร์ เชียงใหม่)

> Brain clinic, physical therapy clinic and TMS brain center in Chiang Mai, Thailand. Treats brain conditions, migraine, stroke, chronic pain and office syndrome, led by specialist neurologists and rehabilitation physicians.

The site is in Thai under `/th/` and English under `/en/` (some English pages fall back to Thai text). A full list of pages is in the [sitemap](https://www.chivacare.com/sitemap.xml).

## Main pages

- [Services](https://www.chivacare.com/th/services): treatments and service categories
- [Promotions](https://www.chivacare.com/th/promotions): current packages and offers
- [Our team](https://www.chivacare.com/th/teams): doctors and physical therapists
- [Book an appointment](https://www.chivacare.com/th/appointment): online booking form
- [Self-assessment](https://www.chivacare.com/th/assessment): symptom questionnaires
- [Contact us](https://www.chivacare.com/th/contactus): phone, location and contact form
